args.message:
I added up order amount minus the ordering customer's discount for each region. The "No region" group (shown as null) holds 16 orders and comes to 1,143.30.

| Region | Amount minus discount |
| --- | --- |
| North | 104,835.76 |
| South | 99,462.90 |
| East | 64,730.70 |
| West | 47,717.79 |
| No region | 1,143.30 |

Some orders in the No region group point to customer IDs that aren't in the customer table, so there is no discount to subtract. I counted their discount as 0. If those orders are dropped instead, the group comes to 627.83. The regions table also lists an "Arctic" region, but no orders map to it, so it doesn't appear.
